description: Sourced country suggestions: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code to a CalculationMethod raw value, with the source that supports it. A missing country has no sourced suggestion. A suggestion is a starting point, not a ruling; METHODS.md explains each entry and the entries that were dropped.

AE.source: AlAdhan, Calculation Methods: the Dubai method (https://aladhan.com/calculation-methods); its angles fit the official Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque Centre timetable for Abu Dhabi (https://www.szgmc.gov.ae/en/worshippers/prayer-timingss), both retrieved 2026-10-13. Secondary.

AF.source: PrayTimes.org, Calculation Methods, regions per method (https://praytimes.org/docs/methods, retrieved 2026-10-13)

BD.source: PrayTimes.org, Calculation Methods, regions per method (https://praytimes.org/docs/methods, retrieved 2026-10-13)

BN.source: Brunei's Ministry of Religious Affairs timetable (https://www.mora.gov.bn/SitePages/WaktuSembahyang.aspx) fits Fajr at 20° and Isha at 18°, the MUIS angles; SalahTimes' own fit, retrieved 2026-10-13

DZ.source: Algeria's Ministry of Religious Affairs calendar for Algiers fits Fajr at 18° and Isha at 17°, the Muslim World League angles; SalahTimes' own fit, retrieved 2026-10-13 (https://marw.gov.dz/media/calendrier/1448/Alger.pdf). The ministry also puts Maghrib about 3.5 minutes after sunset.

EG.source: Dar al-Ifta al-Misriyyah, fatwa 4021 of 20 March 2017 (page 13816): Egypt's Fajr is at 19.5°, and the Egyptian General Authority for Survey issues its official prayer-time calendars; it quotes the astronomer Mervat Awad for 17.5° for Isha (https://www.dar-alifta.org/ar/fatwa/details/13816, retrieved 2026-10-18)

ID.source: Kemenag's Bimas Islam publishes Indonesia's official prayer schedule (https://bimasislam.kemenag.go.id/jadwalshalat, retrieved 2026-10-13)

IN.source: PrayTimes.org, Calculation Methods, regions per method (https://praytimes.org/docs/methods, retrieved 2026-10-13)

IR.source: The Institute of Geophysics, University of Tehran, computes Iran's official times: Fajr at 17.7°, Maghrib at 4.5° (Khabaronline, 22 August 2010, https://khabaronline.ir/news/86445, retrieved 2026-10-13)

JO.source: Jordan's Ministry of Awqaf timetable for Amman (https://www.awqaf.gov.jo/ar/Pages/PrayerTime) fits Fajr and Isha at 18°, the Karachi angles; SalahTimes' own fit, retrieved 2026-10-13. The ministry also puts Maghrib about 6.6 minutes after sunset and sunrise about 6.5 minutes before it (https://github.com/salah-kit/SalahTimes/issues/9).

KW.source: The Al-Ojeiri Scientific Centre's official calendar for Kuwait (https://alojeiri.com/ar/ojeiri-calendar) fits Fajr at 18° and Isha at 17.5°, AlAdhan's 'Kuwait' method (https://api.aladhan.com/v1/methods); SalahTimes' own fit of the 2026 calendar, retrieved 2026-10-18. The Centre doesn't state the angles; AlAdhan, a secondary source, lists them.

MY.source: JAKIM's e-Solat publishes Malaysia's official zone timetables (https://www.e-solat.gov.my); the Federal Territories Mufti states the 18° Subuh adopted in 2019 (https://www.muftiwp.gov.my/en/artikel/al-kafi-li-al-fatawi/4271), retrieved 2026-10-13

PK.source: PrayTimes.org, Calculation Methods, regions per method (https://praytimes.org/docs/methods, retrieved 2026-10-13)

QA.source: Qatar Calendar House (Dar al-Taqweem al-Qatari), the state's approved reference (https://qatarch.com/brief-altakwem): its official Doha timetable fits Fajr at 18° and Isha 90 minutes after Maghrib (https://qatarch.com/public/uploads/orginal/emsakia/emsakya.pdf), retrieved 2026-10-13.

SA.source: Umm al-Qura is Saudi Arabia's official calendar (KACST, https://ummulqura.org.sa); method parameters from PrayTimes.org, which lists it for the Arabian Peninsula (https://praytimes.org/docs/methods, retrieved 2026-10-13). Secondary.

SG.source: MUIS publishes Singapore's official prayer timetable (https://www.muis.gov.sg/-/media/Files/Corporate-Site/Prayer-Timetable-2025.ashx, retrieved 2026-10-13)

TN.source: Tunisia's Ministry of Religious Affairs timetable for Tunis (https://www.affaires-religieuses.tn/public/getData/1) fits Fajr and Isha at 18°, the Karachi angles; SalahTimes' own fit, retrieved 2026-10-13. The ministry also puts Maghrib about 2 minutes after sunset.

TR.source: Diyanet İşleri Başkanlığı publishes Turkey's official times (https://namazvakitleri.diyanet.gov.tr) and its precautionary minutes (https://vakithesaplama.diyanet.gov.tr/temkin.php), retrieved 2026-10-13

US.source: Fiqh Council of North America, How should the times of Fajr and Isha be calculated?, the suggestion of its General Body Meeting of 27–29 October 2017: 'suggests using 15° for both Fajr and Isha in the USA' (https://fiqhcouncil.org/the-suggested-calculation-method-for-fajr-and-isha/, retrieved 2026-10-18). It replaced FCNA's 2011 position, the Moonsighting Committee's method (https://github.com/salah-kit/SalahTimes/issues/8).
